title: AgenticVerificationProof
description: A signed, consensus-backed attestation that an on-chain event occurred. Version avp/1.0. A signed negative (verified:false) is as valid and useful as a signed positive.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version tag. Verifiers MUST reject unknown versions.

verified.description: True if the claimed on-chain fact was confirmed by consensus; false otherwise. When false, `reason` MUST be populated.

chainId.description: EVM chain id the fact was checked against. Base mainnet = 8453.

blockNumber.description: Block number containing the tx. Null when the tx could not be located.

blockHash.description: Canonical hash of the block agreed on by consensus.

txHash.description: Transaction hash the requester asked Tessera to verify.

txIndex.description: Index of the tx within its block. Null when not located.

consensus.description: Multi-source agreement summary. Sources are queried concurrently; a dynamic quorum of responders must agree on blockHash + receipt status.

responders.description: Sources that answered within the timeout.

agreed.description: Number of responders that agreed on the signed value (blockHash + status).

quorum.description: Dynamic threshold (supermajority of responders) that had to be met. `verified` can only be true when agreed >= quorum.

agreedSources.description: Names of the responders that agreed (transparency; usable in a fraud challenge).

finality.description: How settled the block is. `verified:true` requires the block to be final (or >= configured confirmations), so a reorg cannot revert a signed — and bonded — fact. Null when consensus was not reached.

finalized.description: A quorum of sources confirm the block is at/under the finalized tag (or >= min confirmations).

finalizedBlock.description: Consensus finalized-head block number at issue time.

confirmations.description: latest head - block number at issue time.

merkleProof.description: Reserved: inclusion proof against the block's transactions trie (RLP-encoded MPT). Null in the MVP; populated in a later phase.

attestation.description: Cryptographic signature over the canonical form of this proof (all fields except `attestation` itself).

signer.description: Ethereum address of Tessera's oracle signing key.

scheme.description: Signing scheme: EIP-191 personal_sign over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes.

signature.description: 65-byte r||s||v signature, hex. In Phase 0 this is a placeholder zero-signature until the signing key is wired in Phase 1.

bond.description: Honesty stake backing this proof (Phase 3). Null when bonding is disabled. contract/stakedUSDC/challengeWindowSec advertise the oracle's standing bond; anchored/anchorTx indicate whether THIS proof was individually committed on-chain (and is thus trustlessly slashable).

challengeWindowSec.description: Seconds a challenger has to slash an anchored proof.

proofId.description: keccak256 of the canonical proof core (attestation + bond removed); the on-chain anchor key.

anchored.description: Whether this proof was individually anchored on-chain (earmarking part of the standing bond).

anchorTx.description: The anchor transaction hash, when anchored.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation when `verified` is false (e.g. "tx not found in claimed block", "quorum not reached: 1/3 sources agreed"). Null on success.

issuedAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the proof was issued and signed.
